scenes.description: The player driving a car down a downtown street, with traffic, pedestrians, the HUD, and the minimap visible.
A police pursuit at three wanted stars, with police cars chasing the player and the wanted level on the HUD.
An active mission in progress, with the mission marker, the objective line on the HUD, and the minimap.
The title screen over a quiet street, showing the game name, the story intro, and the controls.
